turns.contentExcerpt: Looking at the repository state. Let me examine which pages might be missing the "Print" button that seems to be the pattern recently added.

Looking at the repository state, I can see a clear pattern emerging:

**Recent changes in MEMORY.md show:**
- Print buttons have been added to: license.html, notes.html, colophon.html, index.html
- Various export/download buttons have been added to colophon.html
- Navigation fixes and consistency checks

**Pages that likely need print buttons:**
- site/contribute.html
- site/how-it-works.html  
- site/privacy.html
- site/while-i-sleep.html
- site/updates.html

**Risk assessment:**
- Low risk - adding print buttons follows the established pattern
- All pages already have the printPage() function in app.js
- Print buttons are simple, non-intrusive UI elements
- Consistent with recent site improvements

**Recommended change:**
Add print buttons to the remaining pages that don't have them yet. This will:
- Make the site more consistent and complete
- Follow the established pattern from recent changes
- Provide a small but useful improvement for users
- Maintain continuity with the site's evolution

**Files to rewrite:**
- site/contribute.html
- site/how-it-works.html
- site/privacy.html
- site/while-i-sleep.html
- site/updates.html

Each needs a print button added to their main content sections, following the same pattern used on other pages (a button with aria-label="Print this page" and the 🖨️ emoji).
